messages.title: Welcome to MTG Reforged
messages.body: News from the developer will show up here. Have fun!

messages.title: We reached 50 versions!
messages.body: With this one we have reached 50 versions, full of fixes, improvements and ffeatures for you to enjoy!

messages.title: New in v0.10.0
messages.body:
• Spells that target a card in a graveyard, exile or library now show those cards in a carousel to choose from.
• Collection: keep several printings of the same card (and foil copies) as separate entries; search "All cards" to add any printing.
• Foil cards get keldon-market's holo shine.
• Undo: up to 20 steps, no more endless waiting when used during the opponent's turn (tap again to call it off).
• New app icon.
• Version numbers now go up with every app update; engine-only updates add a letter (0.10.0a).

messages.title: New in v0.58.0
messages.body: • The version number now counts our releases: this is the 58th, so v0.58.0 (the 105th will be v1.05.0). Updates that only bring a newer Forge rules engine keep the number and add a letter: v0.58.0a.

messages.title: New in v0.59.0
messages.body:
• Undo works with a spell on the stack: the spell goes back to your hand.
• Undo while choosing attackers or targets backs out and undoes, instead of loading forever.
• Undo is available from the start of a game, including resumed games.

messages.title: New in v0.60.0
messages.body:
• Undo with spells on the stack now uses the rules engine's own undo, which puts the stack back exactly: undoing a spell no longer re-casts other spells, loses triggered abilities or hands priority to the opponent.
• End Turn keeps ending the turn instead of turning into Undo.

messages.title: New in v0.61.0
messages.body:
• Undo in a resumed game with your spell on the stack puts the spell back in your hand. Games saved from now on also untap the lands that paid for it; in games saved before, those lands stay tapped.
• The undo button no longer lights up when there is nothing to undo yet.

messages.title: New in v0.62.0
messages.body:
• Undo rebuilt from scratch: every time the game waits for your play it saves the whole game (stack included), and undo steps back one prompt at a time, up to 20 times.
• Undo while paying a cost, choosing targets or attacking cancels that play and goes back to before it, instead of loading forever.
• A resumed game starts its history when it opens; undo there can still take back a spell you left on the stack.

messages.title: New in v0.63.0
messages.body: • Resuming a saved game no longer asks again the choices permanents made when they entered (like Sower of Discord's two players): they come back as they were. Applies to games saved from this version on.

messages.title: New in v0.64.0
messages.body: • Saved games keep your last 20 steps: after resuming, undo can go back to before the save. Applies to games saved from this version on.

messages.title: New in v0.65.0
messages.body:
• Resuming a game no longer shows the choices permanents make as they enter (like Sower of Discord's two players): the board is rebuilt quietly and the saved choices are put back. Games saved before v0.64 come back with those choices made by default.
• In a game saved before v0.64, tapping the greyed-out undo explains why there are no steps from before the save.

messages.title: New in v0.66.0
messages.body:
• Rebuilding a resumed board answers optional questions with no, so it can't take a card from your hand.
• The last resumed save is kept as a copy, to look into resume problems.

messages.title: New in v0.67.0
messages.body: • Saved games can be repaired from a computer (support tool).

messages.title: MTG Reforged for Windows
messages.body:
• MTG Reforged now runs on Windows 10 and 11: the same game, screens and decks, with its own installer that keeps itself up to date.
• On a PC: Esc goes back, right-click shows a card, drag with the mouse to flip through cards, F11 for full screen.

messages.title: New in v0.69.0
messages.body: • Faster start: loading the cards takes about 40% less time (from about 7.5 to 4.3 seconds on a fast PC; more on tablets).

messages.title: New in v0.70.0
messages.body: • Much faster start: the app opens with your decks and collection ready, and the rest of the cards finish loading in the background (a small Loading all cards sign shows on the home screen meanwhile). On a fast PC the home screen now appears in about 2.4 seconds instead of 8.7.

messages.title: New in v0.71.0
messages.body: • A Support the developer button on the home screen, with how to help keep MTG Reforged growing.

messages.title: New in v0.72.0
messages.body: • Windows: installing an update from the app now opens the installer. If your copy still closes without installing, install this version once from the website; later updates will work from the app.

messages.title: New in v0.73.0
messages.body: • Windows: Google Drive backup and restore now work.

messages.title: New in v0.74.0
messages.body:
• Backup and restore show a clear green banner when they work (and a red one when they don't).
• Windows: after updating from the app, MTG Reforged opens again by itself when the installer finishes.

messages.title: New in v0.75.0
messages.body: • Windows: Ctrl + mouse wheel zooms the card grids in decks and the collection, like pinch to zoom on Android.

messages.title: New in v0.76.0
messages.body: • Creatures that must attack (goaded, or that attack each combat if able) are marked as attackers for you, and if an attack isn't allowed the message says which creature has to attack and why. Goaded creatures glow red.

messages.title: New in v0.77.0
messages.body: • Floating mana shows each colour's mana symbol, bigger, with the amount underneath (x3).

messages.title: New in v0.78.0
messages.body: • Cards in choice dialogs (ordering cards, picking cards, targets) show big while you press and hold them, or right-click them on Windows.

messages.title: New in v0.79.0
messages.body: • A richer game log: turns as headers, every play (spells, lands, attacks, damage) as a card with the player's avatar and card thumbnails you can hold to see big, and a Go back to before this button within the undo history. The card on the stack also shows big while you hold it.

messages.title: New in v0.80.0
messages.body: • Profile shows the app version and a Check for updates button that looks for a newer version right away.

messages.title: New in v0.81.0
messages.body: • The game log is kept when you save and resume a match. Windows: cards in a match grow a little as you make the window bigger.

messages.title: New in v0.82.0
messages.body: • An aura or equipment on another player's permanent now sits on top of that permanent, with its controller's avatar in the corner, instead of on its controller's side.

messages.title: New in v0.83.0
messages.body: • What's new messages only show for the version you have installed (or older), not for newer versions you haven't installed yet.

messages.title: New in v0.84.0
messages.body: • Game log: every card it mentions has a thumbnail, mana and tap symbols are icons, mana lines show who made the mana, players show their real portraits, calmer cards and a clearer Go back button. Windows: a splash picture shows the moment the app starts.

messages.title: New in v0.85.0
messages.body: • Windows: cards in a match grow noticeably more as you make the window bigger (half of the window's growth).

messages.title: New in v0.86.0
messages.body: • Check for updates shows its result in the same clear green banner as backups (red if something went wrong).

messages.title: New in v0.87.0
messages.body: • Hold the card shown in the side panel (or the card sheet on phones) to see it even bigger.

messages.title: New in v0.88.0
messages.body: • If start-up fails (for example card data damaged by a crash or power cut), the app now says so instead of staying at the loading bar, and reinstalls the card data the next time you open it.

messages.title: New in v0.89.0
messages.body: • If the app can't start, it now looks for a newer version right away and offers to install it from the start-up screen.

messages.title: New in v0.90.0
messages.body: • Phones in portrait: the deck screen is redesigned with Edit and Select always in reach and the rest in a menu; the deck builder and collection keep name and Save up front, move Import / Export / Cheapest to a menu and use icon buttons; the card viewer bar fits in two rows; the home screen and dialogs use the space better.

messages.title: New in v0.91.0
messages.body:
• Phones: one Game settings button on the home screen (game mode, opponents and their decks), the Support button sits at the top, and the title has more room.
• Phones, deck screen: New deck and My decks sit next to Edit and Select, and the commander, colours and price box is smaller.
• Phones, deck builder and collection: Filters and List together at the top, a slimmer search with the card count and price beside it, mana and card type filters on two rows, and header buttons as tall as the name box.
• Icon-only buttons have their icon centred.

messages.title: New in v0.92.0
messages.body:
• Phones get a match screen of their own: identical permanents pile up as one card with a count, each opponent has a tab with their life and cards (the one whose turn it is comes forward), the stack fits in one line (tap it for the full list), the hand is a low row you open by swiping its handle up, and the buttons are big and at the bottom.
• Phones: when you can't play anything, priority passes by itself.
• Phones start 1 on 1, and Game settings warns that more opponents make the boards smaller.
• Every search box has an X to clear it; the card lookup closes by tapping outside it.
• Tablets keep their match screen as it was.

messages.title: New in v0.93.0
messages.body:
• The number of opponents you choose is kept after picking their decks (it went back to the default).
• Phones: the message above the match buttons shows in full.

messages.title: New in v0.94.0
messages.body:
• Android: scan cards into your collection with the camera (camera button in the collection). It reads the name and the set code and number, so it picks the right printing; you can also scan from a single set. Each card shows up at the bottom: swipe sideways for another printing, up or down for how many, tap for foil, and Save adds them all.
• Phones: opponents' turns no longer fly by when you can't respond, and the turn banner is smaller.

messages.title: New in v0.95.0
messages.body:
• Card scanner: reads the name only from the card's title (not the type line or rules text), waits a moment for the set code and number so it picks the exact printing, and corrects a guessed printing while the card stays in view.
• Card scanner: a Foil chip for foil copies, and the small cards in the carousel take swipes up and down for how many.

messages.title: New in v0.96.0
messages.body:
• Card scanner: recognises cards printed with an alternative name (like The Dead Marshes, a Lord of the Rings Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth) and picks that printing.
• Card scanner: with other cards in view (a binder page), the set code and number are taken from the card being scanned, not a neighbour's.

messages.title: New in v0.97.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: only reads what you see on screen; cards the camera catches beyond the edges of the picture are ignored.

messages.title: New in v0.98.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: tapping a card in the carousel brings it back to the front, big, to change its printing or make it foil.

messages.title: New in v0.99.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: tapping a small card in the carousel now really brings it to the front, and tapping the big card switches it between regular and foil.

messages.title: New in v1.00.0
messages.body:
• Price check by camera: the camera button in the home search box scans a card and shows it big with its price; swipe for other printings, tap for foil.
• Collection scanner: shows the price of the card in front.

messages.title: New in v1.01.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: the frame fills all the room between the top and the cards below, and the price check shows the card bigger.

messages.title: New in v1.02.0
messages.body: • Decks: New asks whether you're building a 60-card deck or a Commander deck, whatever the game settings say.

messages.title: New in v1.03.0
messages.body: • Updates: when a new version is still being built, the app says so and shows how far along the build is; once it's out, the Update button appears by itself.

messages.title: New in v1.04.0
messages.body: • Dark mode: the paper grain is softer, a sandy tea-with-milk tone instead of bright cream.

messages.title: New in v1.05.0
messages.body: • Updates: a version still being built shows only when you tap Check for updates in your profile, not on the home screen.

messages.title: New in v1.06.0
messages.body: • Turning the phone no longer sends you back to the home screen: the deck editor, the scanner and every other screen stay where you were.

messages.title: New in v1.07.0
messages.body: • Collection on phones: Delete collection moved into the ⋮ menu, away from the everyday buttons.

messages.title: New in v1.08.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: recognises cards printed in Spanish by their Spanish name too.

messages.title: New in v1.09.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: picks the right printing more often. The collector number is checked against the card's own printings even when the set code is misread, and common reading slips in the number are forgiven.

messages.title: New in v1.10.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: older cards get their printing right more often. The small "73/175" number counts even in moments the name isn't read, and without a number the year on the copyright line picks that year's set instead of the newest printing.

messages.title: New in v1.11.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: the camera reads at a higher resolution so the small print at the bottom of a card (set code, number, year) is legible, and a line under the hint shows what it read.

messages.title: New in v1.12.0
messages.body: • Card scanner: only reads what's inside the white frame, so text from other cards around it (like a name in flavour text) is no longer taken for a card.

messages.title: New in v1.13.0
messages.body: • Offline card images: a new Delete button removes the card pictures already downloaded (they download again when needed).

messages.title: New in v1.14.0
messages.body: • Check for updates: once the update being built comes out, it now shows as available instead of staying on the build progress.
